exact_applications_root_assessed.closed_compact_Kahler_products: K=C(w1+w2) dominates beta; S=K+ddq and S0 are closed positive currents on P1xP1, independently of nonclosed beta. Compact finiteness applies only to these closed currents.
exact_applications_root_assessed.small_unbounded_locus: Every q~U is locally bounded off the single closed complete pluripolar divisor D. The separated reference has zero first-degree polar current and full degree-two closed mass. Theorem1.16 is applied in both ordinary orders and separately in degrees1 and2, never to nonclosed beta.
exact_applications_root_assessed.polar_trace: Equality of first-degree classes makes the positive polar current S-<S> have zero trace against K, hence vanish. Smooth-background expansion and distributional Stokes then need q in L1 only. No nonlinear first-moment integration by parts is used.
exact_applications_root_assessed.canonical_removal_and_descent: Add a local quadratic dominating the smooth background; use local upper bounds and closed analytic pluripolar centers for canonical extension. Retaining the sharper nonclosed lower bound requires coefficient-measure positivity on the center and zero center mass for the smooth correction, and is proved separately in the author argument.
exact_applications_root_assessed.exceptional_curve_restriction: Mutual type makes the potential locally bounded near the exceptional curve blown up outside D. Holomorphic psh restriction is then genuine and finite; constant lower-Hessian approximation retains positive tangential curvature, contradicting curve Stokes. No singular arbitrary-fiber current restriction is used.

source_potential_normalization: The cited qualitative closed-current comparisons and finiteness statements are invariant under a positive rescaling of the dd^c operator when the actual currents and potential singularity orders are retained. The original i/(2pi) operator and logarithm-squared Poincare--Lelong convention remain unchanged.
